    deviations.append(dev1)

# Check k2 (must be <= n)

    S2 = k2 * x_i
    dev2 = abs(S2 - T)
    deviations.append(dev2)

# Since the sequence is uniform, these two closest multiples should yield the minimum deviation.
min_deviation = min(deviations)

print(f"k closest to {T}/{x_i:.2f} are k1={k1} and k2={k2}")
print(f"Deviation for k1={k1}: |{k1}*51 - 1810| = {abs(k1*51 - T)}")
print(f"Deviation for k2={k2}: |{k2}*51 - 1810| = {abs(k2*51 - T)}")
print(f"Minimum deviation D(X): {min_deviation}")
